description: This is a Java interface named 'Jsonifiable' that defines a contract for objects that can be represented as JSON. It includes methods for converting objects to JSON representations, supporting different schema versions, and applying predicates, pointers, or field selectors to customize the JSON output.

classes.name: Jsonifiable
classes.description: An interface representing entities that can be converted to JSON, supporting multiple schema versions and various customizations.

classes.name: Jsonifiable.WithPredicate
classes.description: An extension of Jsonifiable that allows conversion to JSON with additional predicate-based filtering.

classes.name: Jsonifiable.WithPointer
classes.description: An extension of Jsonifiable that allows conversion to JSON with JSON Pointer targeting specific fields.

classes.name: Jsonifiable.WithFieldSelector
classes.description: An extension of Jsonifiable that enables JSON conversion based on a JsonFieldSelector.

classes.name: Jsonifiable.WithFieldSelectorAndPredicate
classes.description: An extension of Jsonifiable combining field selection and predicate filtering for JSON output.

methods.name: getLatestSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the latest supported JsonSchemaVersion for the implementing class.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns all schema versions supported by the class.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version the instance implements, defaulting to the latest schema version.

methods.name: implementsSchemaVersion
methods.description: Checks if a given integer schema version is supported.

methods.name: implementsSchemaVersion
methods.description: Checks if a given JsonSchemaVersion is supported.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to a JSON value.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Returns the JSON string representation of the object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to JSON with a predicate to filter contents.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to JSON with a specified schema version and predicate.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Returns the JSON string with predicate filter applied.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Returns the JSON string with schema version and predicate filter.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to JSON targeted by a JsonPointer.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to JSON with schema version and JsonPointer.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Returns JSON string targeted by a JsonPointer.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Returns JSON string with schema version and JsonPointer.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to JSON using a JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to JSON with schema version and a field selector.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Returns JSON string filtered by a field selector.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Returns JSON string with schema version and field selector.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to JSON with both a field selector and predicate.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the object to JSON given schema version, field selector, and predicate.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Returns JSON string with field selector and predicate.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Returns JSON string with schema version, field selector, and predicate.
